[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In Bob's Obsidian, Ctrl+W followed by a key focuses, moves, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]creates main-area splits from the keyboard. h/l focus the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]neighbouring split, H/L move the current tab into, out of, or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]across splits (creating and collapsing splits as needed) without [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]losing its editor state, and a calm, theme-native hint shows [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exactly what each key will do.[/#D7D7AF]
